verdict.rationale: Ramp documents policy checks before spend (ramp-docs-9,18), automated approval recommendations (ramp-docs-10), role-based approval workflows (ramp-docs-12), and explicit audit logging of every action including agent/API writes ('every write operation lands in the customer's Ramp audit log automatically') plus a dedicated audit_logs:read API scope. However there's no direct documentation of an immutable/exportable audit trail specifically designed to survive external audit (e.g., SOC2/compliance certification, audit-export tooling, or edit-history retention guarantees). Missing for 10: explicit external-audit/compliance certification evidence, documented audit-log export/retention format, and independent verification that historical edits are immutably preserved.
